title: Talk to support
summary: Falar com o suporte in Ajuda e sobre (ADR 0114): opens the person's one chat with the Suporte Bipe account, making it on first use.

phase.description: opening: POST /v1/me/support runs and the room is joined. failed: shows bipe_support_open_failed.

open.effect: POST /v1/me/support, then joins the room when the person is only invited (Client.joinRoomById), then opens chat-timeline for it. 503 support_unavailable shows bipe_support_open_failed.

notes: The room is encrypted like every room; the support bot has its own device and reads it. The topic (bipe_support_room_topic) says the team reads the chat in a support tool and that photos and files stay on the Bipe server.
The bot sends bipe_support_welcome on first use; the app shows no extra screen.
In the chat list the support room shows as Suporte Bipe with the support account's photo, like a DM.
Bipe logic: BipeAPIClient.supportRoomID (iOS), BipeSupportChat.open and BipeApiClient.supportRoomId (Android).
